verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. The docs say it supports over a dozen platforms, and the API reference notes it is used by its official SDKs. The pack shows specific ones: the official rollbar.js repo covering client and server JavaScript (React, Angular, Express, Next.js), a Ruby gem, a Magento 2 module, an Apple SDK module, and .NET Notifier internal-event hooks. Its llms.txt also points developers to SDK installation docs. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and no consolidated list of officially maintained SDKs or their versioning and support status.
